sections.Profile:
Pop 3000 is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine built by Bill Port of Madrid, Spain; Pop 4000 is the same machine with different artwork.

- Manufacturer: Bill Port
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, 1970s
